title: Router processes and resilience: process groups, reaping, boot-id identity, network timeouts, watch-loop backoff, lease renewal thread
description: Parts (a), (c) and (f) of kbs-7bf31f in both runtimes. Spawn adapters in their own process group (setsid / start_new_session), kill the group on cancel and timeout and always wait after kill; boot-id process identity in Rust like Python's router_adapters.py; connect and read timeouts on the GitHub client; route all network git through router_git_command and ROUTER_GIT_TIMEOUT; log-and-continue with backoff on poll errors in the watch loop, exiting only on configuration or fence errors; renew soft leases from the RouterLeaseRenewalGuard thread. Keep router.workflow unchanged. Acceptance: a test spawns an adapter that forks a sleeping grandchild, cancels, and asserts no survivors; a simulated 500 from GitHub does not stop the watch loop.
